T012 complete. Now T013: mark both tasks done and run the re-verification.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && sed -i 's/^- \\[ \\] T012 /- [X] T012 /; s/^- \\[ \\] T013 /- [X] T013 /' specs/001-transactions/tasks.md && echo '=== T013 verify 1: Open Gaps note present ===' && grep -n 'Open Gaps' specs/001-transactions/research.md && echo '=== T013 verify 2: tasks.md append-only, prior 11 unchanged ===' && head -n $(wc -l < /tmp/tasks_before.md) specs/001-transactions/tasks.md | diff - /tmp/tasks_before.md && echo 'PRIOR-CONTENT-UNCHANGED' && grep -c '^- \\[X\\]' specs/001-transactions/tasks.md && grep -c '^- \\[ \\]' specs/001-transactions/tasks.md && echo '=== T013 verify 3: full suite still green ===' && PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest -o addopts=\"\" > /tmp/t013_full.out 2>&1; echo \"FULL-EXIT:$?\"; tail -2 /tmp/t013_full.out && PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -m pytest -o addopts=\"\" tests/test_smoke.py > /tmp/t013_target.out 2>&1; echo \"TARGET-EXIT:$?\"; tail -2 /tmp/t013_target.out"}
